fields.Name: PRs Waiting On You
fields.Description: Weekday morning review-queue digest surfacing open GitHub pull requests waiting on your review (oldest and stale >24h first) alongside CI or review blockers on your own open PRs.
fields.WakeReason: Review-queue check via Get GitHub Reviews Waiting On Me and Get My GitHub PRs: surface open PRs awaiting the user's review (highlighting stale >24h requests oldest first with GitHub links) plus any failing CI or changes-requested blockers on the user's own PRs; stay silent when clear.
